title: Psalm 65
opening_line: Praise waits for thee in Zion, Lord:

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: to thee vows paid shall be.
text.normalized: To thee vows paid shall be.
text.reading: to thee vows paid shall be.

text.diplomatic: O thou that hearer art of pray’r,
text.normalized: O thou that hearer art of pray’r,

text.normalized: We surely shall be satisfied
